description: This header file defines the interface for the file descriptor logging subsystem in the lighttpd project. It includes structure definitions, function prototypes for initializing, freeing, opening, closing, flushing, cycling, waiting for process IDs, restarting, abandoning pids, and handling pipes related to logging operations.

methods.name: fdlog_init
methods.description: Initializes a new fdlog_st instance with the given filename, file descriptor, and mode.

methods.name: fdlog_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with an fdlog_st instance.

methods.name: fdlog_open
methods.description: Opens a new logging descriptor given a filename.

methods.name: fdlog_closeall
methods.description: Closes all logging descriptors represented by the given error handler.

methods.name: fdlog_files_flush
methods.description: Flushes log files, with a parameter indicating memory release.

methods.name: fdlog_files_cycle
methods.description: Cycles log files, possibly for log rotation.

methods.name: fdlog_pipes_waitpid_cb
methods.description: Waits on a process ID, returning status.

methods.name: fdlog_pipes_restart
methods.description: Restarts pipe-based logging mechanisms after a given timestamp.

methods.name: fdlog_pipes_abandon_pids
methods.description: Abandons all tracked process IDs related to pipes.

methods.name: fdlog_pipe_serrh
methods.description: Handles errors on a pipe's file descriptor.

methods.name: fdlog_closelog
methods.description: Closes the syslog logging facility, if used.

methods.name: fdlog_openlog
methods.description: Opens the syslog with a specified facility buffer.
